name: problem statement over a blurred backdrop
looks: A tiny eyebrow label fades in, then a two-line problem statement rises into view over a flat, airy gradient field: a plain first line, then a softer italic line that lands a beat later naming the real cost. Behind the text a heavily blurred screenshot washes the field in soft colour.
build: Eyebrow label fades ~0.15s; first line rises 6-8px on power2.out; the italic second line follows at lower opacity after a short pause; background is a blurred (40-60px) scaled screenshot under a gradient wash.
sound: A soft intake on the label and a light rise under each line landing.
prompt: Open on a tiny eyebrow label fading in, then a two-line problem statement rising into frame over a flat gradient field, the first line plain, the second softer and italic, naming the real cost a beat later. Wash the background in a heavily blurred, color-matched echo of the product so the field never sits empty.
